errors.push_delivery_failed: The push service could not be reached or refused the notification. The server log names the error type.
errors.push_stale: This subscription is no longer valid (expired, or the server's push key changed) and was removed. Subscribe this browser again.
errors.push_timeout: The push service did not answer in time.
errors.notification_test_failed: The destination could not be reached or refused the test. The server log names the error type.
errors.notification_destination_invalid: This destination is not set up, or its address is invalid.
